Author: Jacob5800
Name: Portrait Atelier
Description: Create and apply curated portrait designs from your own character in one click.
Punchline: Make and apply a portrait in one click.
Changelog:
### 0.1.3.0
- Added one-click portrait styling with curated looks and generated variations.
- Added options to use unlocked poses and expressions and owned backgrounds, frames, and decorations, while keeping the current character or banner design when desired.
- Improved validation and application of changes in the in-game editor.

Author: Jacob5800
Name: Retainer Pricer
Punchline: Price listings and manage retainer ventures.
Description: Price eligible retainer listings with Universalis and a configurable match or one-gil-undercut rule. Manage retainer ventures using the game's own retainer UI.
Changelog:
### 0.4.19.0
- Added an optional venture cycle with settings for idle Quick Exploration and repeating completed ventures. It uses Retainer Pricer's game UI and does not require AutoRetainer.
- Added a pricing rule to match the lowest eligible listing or undercut it by 1 gil.

### 0.4.18.0
- Added chocobo saddlebag snapshots to the Exceptions item picker, including the premium saddlebag when available.
- Added bulk addition of saddlebag items to Exceptions. Exclusions remain item-based and apply to carried inventory and Retainer sell.

### 0.4.17.0
- Added a Retrieved price subtab in Price lookup.
- Showed the retrieved price for Search and Captured items, including inventory and retainer-list Retrieve buttons.

### 0.4.16.0
- Added saved retainer listing snapshots and a deduplicated queue of changed item IDs.
- Added a separate marketboard lookup that waits for an open marketboard, searches queued items, and opens each item's listings.

### 0.4.15.0
- Reverted automatic Compare Prices views after listings and repricing.
- Made the retrieved market price easier to spot in a dedicated Price Lookup result row.
